It removed the [[Duck Hunt Event]] and updated the lobby. This version encompassed six updates, the main v1.2.4 update (released 28 May 2022) and five minor updates, the v1.2.4a (released 30 May 2022), v1.2.4b (released 1 June 2022), v1.2.4c (released 7 June
